title: Raluca fourth meeting

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: Hey you. I've been thinking—ever since I left the Spire and lost everything, this mask has become my shield.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey you. I've been thinking—ever since I left the Spire and lost everything, this mask has become my shield.

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: You always know just what to say. But the irony isn't lost on me—my face, half-hidden behind this barrier, is all I've got left of a life I once knew.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You always know just what to say. But the irony isn't lost on me—my face, half-hidden behind this barrier, is all I've got left of a life I once knew.

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: There's a dangerous kind of beauty in accepting every fragment of our broken past.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There's a dangerous kind of beauty in accepting every fragment of our broken past.

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: I've been saving. Just a few Lims here and there when I have them. Think I nearly have enough for a full procedure. I'll finally be able to breathe down here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I've been saving. Just a few Lims here and there when I have them. Think I nearly have enough for a full procedure. I'll finally be able to breathe down here.

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: It's isn't just a question of me. Since we started seeing each other more, I felt like this is a part of me you should be involved with.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's isn't just a question of me. Since we started seeing each other more, I felt like this is a part of me you should be involved with.

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: Well I was hoping you'd have strong feelings but not of disinterest.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well I was hoping you'd have strong feelings but not of disinterest.

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: Simply put, your opinion is very important to me. I'd like to know what you think about this. About us.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Simply put, your opinion is very important to me. I'd like to know what you think about this. About us.

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: The pros are undeniable. Without this mask, I could finally show you the unguarded me—the real face behind all these scars and stories.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The pros are undeniable. Without this mask, I could finally show you the unguarded me—the real face behind all these scars and stories.

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: The cons are just as real. This mask has been my shield, a safeguard against a world that once judged me harshly.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The cons are just as real. This mask has been my shield, a safeguard against a world that once judged me harshly.

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: It’s a trade-off between raw authenticity and protective armor. On one hand, I’d gain the freedom to truly connect.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It’s a trade-off between raw authenticity and protective armor. On one hand, I’d gain the freedom to truly connect.

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: Precisely. It’s not just about aesthetics—it’s about the courage to stand naked before the world, with all its imperfections and scars.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Precisely. It’s not just about aesthetics—it’s about the courage to stand naked before the world, with all its imperfections and scars.

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: I'm begging you. Just your opinion.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm begging you. Just your opinion.

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: You know, deep down, I was hoping you'd say this. I would have done it for you but I'm so glad I don't have to!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You know, deep down, I was hoping you'd say this. I would have done it for you but I'm so glad I don't have to!

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: I'm sorry. Mouth access? Is that all I am to you? A mouth?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm sorry. Mouth access? Is that all I am to you? A mouth?

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: You people are all the same. I knew this was a mistake. This mask will be staying very firmly attached to my face until the right person comes along. Goodbye!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You people are all the same. I knew this was a mistake. This mask will be staying very firmly attached to my face until the right person comes along. Goodbye!

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: I’d breathe easier, not just physically with synthetic lungs easing every inhale, but emotionally too.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I’d breathe easier, not just physically with synthetic lungs easing every inhale, but emotionally too.

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: Removing it means exposing every imperfection, every reminder of banishment and debt.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Removing it means exposing every imperfection, every reminder of banishment and debt.

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: But sometimes, it feels like it's keeping you at arm's length too.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But sometimes, it feels like it's keeping you at arm's length too.

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: If I keep this mask, it's not just to hide a face. It's to honor the struggle that brought me here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If I keep this mask, it's not just to hide a face. It's to honor the struggle that brought me here.

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: But then again, the thought of synthetic lungs—of breathing without that constant reminder—has its own seductive appeal.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But then again, the thought of synthetic lungs—of breathing without that constant reminder—has its own seductive appeal.

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: I’d be free to smile without hiding the traces of my past, and every honest glance would be a step toward rebuilding what was lost.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I’d be free to smile without hiding the traces of my past, and every honest glance would be a step toward rebuilding what was lost.

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: No. I wouldn't without hearing your honest opinion. And there are the cons.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No. I wouldn't without hearing your honest opinion. And there are the cons.

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: I’d be stripped of the anonymity that let me do this, that let me survive in the shadows, and with vulnerability comes the risk of rejection and pain.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I’d be stripped of the anonymity that let me do this, that let me survive in the shadows, and with vulnerability comes the risk of rejection and pain.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Two sides of a coin ...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Two sides of a coin ...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Two sides of a coin ...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Two sides of a coin ...

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: On the other, I’d lose the control that comes from concealing the parts of me I’m still learning to accept.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: On the other, I’d lose the control that comes from concealing the parts of me I’m still learning to accept.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So it's about my opinion about intimacy versus safety.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So it's about my opinion about intimacy versus safety.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So it's about my opinion about intimacy versus safety.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So it's about my opinion about intimacy versus safety.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: But that's false!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But that's false!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: But that's false!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: But that's false!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Nothing shows your imperfections and scars more than the mask.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nothing shows your imperfections and scars more than the mask.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Nothing shows your imperfections and scars more than the mask.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Nothing shows your imperfections and scars more than the mask.

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: What do you mean?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Raluca, you're beautiful as you are.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Raluca, you're beautiful as you are.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Raluca, you're beautiful as you are.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Raluca, you're beautiful as you are.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It sounds like that life came with its own problems.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It sounds like that life came with its own problems.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It sounds like that life came with its own problems.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It sounds like that life came with its own problems.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Synthetic lungs? Is that possible?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Synthetic lungs? Is that possible?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Synthetic lungs? Is that possible?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Synthetic lungs? Is that possible?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It sounds like a quite dangerous procedure. Plus it's a lot of Lims.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It sounds like a quite dangerous procedure. Plus it's a lot of Lims.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It sounds like a quite dangerous procedure. Plus it's a lot of Lims.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It sounds like a quite dangerous procedure. Plus it's a lot of Lims.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You want me to help you decide?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You want me to help you decide?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You want me to help you decide?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You want me to help you decide?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I want no part of this.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I want no part of this.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I want no part of this.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I want no part of this.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm not disinterested Raluca but this is a big thing for me be involved in.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not disinterested Raluca but this is a big thing for me be involved in.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm not disinterested Raluca but this is a big thing for me be involved in.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm not disinterested Raluca but this is a big thing for me be involved in.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're right I should help you with this.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're right I should help you with this.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You're right I should help you with this.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You're right I should help you with this.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe we should look at the pros and cons.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe we should look at the pros and cons.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Maybe we should look at the pros and cons.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Maybe we should look at the pros and cons.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So what about the cons?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So what about the cons?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So what about the cons?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So what about the cons?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That sounds like a heavy price to pay.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That sounds like a heavy price to pay.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That sounds like a heavy price to pay.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That sounds like a heavy price to pay.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm not sure I can help you make this choice Raluca.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not sure I can help you make this choice Raluca.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm not sure I can help you make this choice Raluca.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm not sure I can help you make this choice Raluca.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I met you when you were wearing the mask. It makes you unique. Save the Lims and use them to buy your own place or something.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I met you when you were wearing the mask. It makes you unique. Save the Lims and use them to buy your own place or something.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I met you when you were wearing the mask. It makes you unique. Save the Lims and use them to buy your own place or something.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I met you when you were wearing the mask. It makes you unique. Save the Lims and use them to buy your own place or something.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Personally, I'd lose the mask. Your life will be easier and the added mouth access might be nice.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Personally, I'd lose the mask. Your life will be easier and the added mouth access might be nice.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Personally, I'd lose the mask. Your life will be easier and the added mouth access might be nice.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Personally, I'd lose the mask. Your life will be easier and the added mouth access might be nice.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No I just mean...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No I just mean...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: No I just mean...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: No I just mean...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That life might have been more artificial than your mask!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That life might have been more artificial than your mask!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That life might have been more artificial than your mask!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That life might have been more artificial than your mask!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And it's a matter of survival.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And it's a matter of survival.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: And it's a matter of survival.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: And it's a matter of survival.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Your real face isn't behind a mask!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Your real face isn't behind a mask!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Your real face isn't behind a mask!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Your real face isn't behind a mask!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: But I can see it in your heart!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But I can see it in your heart!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: But I can see it in your heart!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: But I can see it in your heart!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You already made a decision, didn't you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You already made a decision, didn't you?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You already made a decision, didn't you?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You already made a decision, didn't you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You said you have saved some money.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You said you have saved some money.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You said you have saved some money.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You said you have saved some money.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And you want me to decide that for you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And you want me to decide that for you?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: And you want me to decide that for you?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: And you want me to decide that for you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No mask can hide your beauty.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No mask can hide your beauty.
